## :bug: Bug-fix PR
## :pushpin: Summary
Fixes iframe embedding by properly handling empty X_FRAME_OPTIONS environment variable override in Docker deployments.

## :link: Related Issue
[#1327](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/1327)

## :ladybug: Root Cause
Middleware falsy check ignored X_FRAME_OPTIONS="" environment variable, preventing iframe embedding configuration.

## :test_tube: Verification
:white_check_mark: Empty X_FRAME_OPTIONS="" now disables X-Frame-Options header
:white_check_mark: Environment variables properly override default
:white_check_mark: Docker compatibility confirmed

## :white_check_mark: Checklist
:ballot_box_with_check: Code formatted
:ballot_box_with_check: No breaking changes to MCP clients
